name: postslop
title: Postslop
description: Write once and publish with Postslop, on this Mac or on your server.
author: local

commands.name: postslop
commands.title: Postslop
commands.description: Compose, attach images, and publish inside Raycast with Postslop.

commands.name: publish-background
commands.title: Finish Publishing
commands.description: Finishes a saved Postslop submission in the background and shows its result.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Server URL
preferences.description: A Postslop running on another machine, such as https://postslop.example.com. Leave empty to use the local checkout below.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: That server's POSTSLOP_TOKEN. Leave empty if it has none.

preferences.name: projectPath
preferences.title: Postslop Server Folder
preferences.description: Used when no Server URL is set: the server folder of your Postslop checkout, containing bin/postslop. Social sessions stay there.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist -o dist
scripts.lint: eslint src && prettier --check src package.json tsconfig.json README.md eslint.config.mjs
